A mod that displays additional information on various objects.


[color=#f4f4f4][size=6]Prerequisites[/size][/color]

You need [b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b] to run any kind of mods. And of course you need [b][url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/]Stardew Valley[/url][/b].
1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
2. Unzip the latest [b]Informant [/b]to the [b]Mods/[/b] folder
3. If you want to use spacechase0's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], this mod automatically hooks into its menu.


[color=#f4f4f4][size=6]Usage[/size][/color]
[size=3]
The mod is automatically present in the game. 

You just need to move the mouse over the object you wish to get the information from.

If you don't like one or more of the displayed information (or worse, if there are conflicts with other mods), you
can disable each type via in game Mod Options or by editing config.json.
[/size][spoiler]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/43KD9ZzH/image.png[/img]
[/spoiler]
[size=3]
[color=#f4f4f4][b]Crop tooltip[/b]: how many days till harvest, which fertilizer is used([/color][color=#00ff00]new![/color][/size][size=3]). Supports tea bush[color=#f4f4f4]([/color][color=#00ff00]new![/color][color=#f4f4f4])[/color].[/size]

[size=3][b]Tree tooltip[/b]: regular trees, wild trees[color=#f4f4f4]([/color][color=#00ff00]new![/color][color=#f4f4f4])[/color], and fruit trees. Optional tree growth stage display([color=#00ff00]new![/color]).[/size]

[size=3][b]Machine tooltip[/b][color=#f4f4f4]: how long till the machine outputs and its product.[/color]
[b]
[/b][b]Animal tooltip[color=#f4f4f4]([/color][color=#00ff00]new![/color][color=#f4f4f4])[/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4]: currently only the hearts of animal and your pet([/color][color=#00ff00]new![/color][color=#f4f4f4]) are shown, since petting is indicated by hand shaped cursor.[/color][/size][size=3]

[b]Sell price tooltip[/b]: display the sell price of item, individual and stack.
[b]
[/b][b]New recipe tooltip[/b]: display the newly added recipes.

[b]Seed decorator([color=#00ff00]new![/color])[/b]: displays the seed product and its value.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gottyduke/stardew-informant/main/Informant/assets/bundle.png[/img]﻿﻿ [b]Bundle decorator[/b]: indicates whether the item is required for a bundle and its quantity[color=#f4f4f4]([/color][color=#00ff00]new![/color][color=#f4f4f4])[/color]. Only shown if quality is met[color=#f4f4f4]([/color][color=#00ff00]new![/color][color=#f4f4f4])[/color].
[i]The new raccoon bundles in 1.6 is not shown, can be added if needed.[/i]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gottyduke/stardew-informant/main/Informant/assets/shipping_bin.png[/img] [b]Shipping bin decorator[/b]: indicates whether the item has been shipped atleast once yet. Tracks only the Collection Page items by default.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gottyduke/stardew-informant/main/Informant/assets/field_office.png[/img] [b]Field office decorator[/b]: indicates whether the item is required for field office turn in.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gottyduke/stardew-informant/main/Informant/assets/museum.png[/img] [b]Museum decorator[/b]: indicates whether the item is required for museum turn in.
[b]
[/b][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gottyduke/stardew-informant/main/Informant/assets/rarecrow.png[/img] [b]Rarecrow decorator[/b]: indicates whether the item is a missing collectable﻿ of rarecrows.[/size]


[size=6]Translator Guide[/size]

Right now, not all translations are provided. If you want to help, translate either file in the [i][url=https://github.com/gottyduke/stardew-informant/blob/main/Informant/i18n/]i18n/[/url][/i] and test it right in your Stardew Valley (the same folder exists in your [i]Mods/[/i] folder). You can then provide it to me via [url=https://github.com/gottyduke/stardew-informant/fork]pull request[/url] or [url=https://github.com/gottyduke/stardew-informant/issues]issue[/url], or any reachable means.
